1: All things breathing, all things existing, all things living, all beings whatever, should not be slain, nor treated with violence, nor abused, nor tormented, nor driven away.
This is the pure, unchangeable, eternal law, which the wise who know the world have declared.
2: Subduing his passions, and free from sin, the mendicant who wanders from village to village should not kill nor cause to be killed any living being.
He should not himself do any sinful act, nor cause another to do it, nor consent to the sinful act of another.
